paper_metadata.title: Influences of ruthenium and crystallographic orientation on creep behavior of aluminized nickel-base single crystal superalloys

conflicts.topic: effect of Ru addition on TCP phase precipitation
conflicts.claim_a: Ru addition suppresses TCP phase precipitation
conflicts.claim_b: Ru addition indirectly promotes TCP phase precipitation beneath the coating in aluminized specimens

evidence.quote: It has previously been reported that the addition of Ru suppressed the TCP phase precipitation [18]. In contrast, in the present study, the addition of Ru seemed to promote the formation of TCP phases beneath the coating.
